name: NewsNation
ability: Your Republican and Democratic currency both count toward either candidate.
flavor: Nexstar's cable channel, launched in 2020, sold itself as news for the whole country rather than one side of it.

name: The Associated Press
ability: At the end of the game, +1 wealth for each big state you called, win or lose.
flavor: The AP has declared the winners of American elections since 1848; newsrooms everywhere wait for its call.

name: The New York Times
flavor: The Gray Lady passed 10 million subscribers in 2023. Its front page is still where a story becomes official.

name: The Wall Street Journal
ability: The first and second Economic stories you play each turn give +1 neutral each.
flavor: Published by Dow Jones since 1889, the paper markets read first: prices, rates and the cost of everything.

name: Politico
ability: Once a turn, pay 2 neutral: take the topmost story in the main deck (pass over states). It joins your hand after you draw at clean-up.
flavor: Founded in 2007 to cover Washington faster than anyone. Its Playbook newsletter sets the capital's morning agenda.

name: The New York Post
ability: Once a turn, discard a Scandal from your hand to draw 3 cards.
flavor: Founded by Alexander Hamilton in 1801, now the country's best-known tabloid. A scandal is tomorrow's front page.

name: Fox News
ability: Once a turn, when you play your second Social story, draw a card.
flavor: The most-watched cable news network of 2024. Its audience turns a moment into a movement.

name: CNN
ability: +1 neutral for each different negative story you play this turn.
flavor: CNN hosted the June debate in Atlanta that reshaped the race, and put both sides on its panels every night.
